title: 3.3.1 SMS auth not working
body: I am not able to confirm/auth SMS request: - Current running and working version 3.2.0.4 with SMS + Authenticator App - Made a fresh backup - Upgraded from 3.2.0.4 to 3.3.1.0 without any problem - Reboot - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Wrong Code" - Imported backup from 3.2.0.4 - Reboot - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Wrong Code" - Creating new secret in settings - Scanning new QR-code - Verify new secret with current PIN - App returns OK - Press "Reset Authenticators" - Back to previous screen - PIN field shows strange/encrypted content and not my PIN (please see screenshot) but editing shows right value in input field - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Wrong Code" - Reboot - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Wrong Code" - Editing PIN (by just confirm and get rid of strange value in overview) - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Wrong Code" - Reverting to 3.2.0.4 - Reimporting latest Backup - Sending SMS like "BOLUS 1" and 2nd SMS with with CODE+PIN Return "Success" But of course i am not sure if the bug is in front of my desk, but i tried everything and i am not able to get it running.
